results.title: Shriya Lohia Exclusive: India’s First Female F4 Racer On Gender Barriers In Motorsport — ‘We’re All Racing Drivers’
results.description: Shriya Lohia opens up about her journey from a nine-year-old go-kart racer to India’s first female F4 racer, breaking gender barriers, overcoming challenges and inspiring more young girls to pursue motorsport at the We Women Want Conclave & Shakti Awards 2026 hosted by The Sunday Guardian. The post Shriya Lohia Exclusive: India’s First Female F4 Racer On Gender Barriers In Motorsport — ‘We’re All Racing Drivers’ appeared first on The Sunday Guardian .

results.title: Chicago Fire FC score three late, defeat Santos Laguna 3-1 for second Leagues Cup win
results.description: Chicago Fire FC made the most of their second contest of the week at SeatGeek Stadium in Bridgeview and managed to put three goals past Santos Laguna after the 71st minute to defeat their Liga MX foes 3-1 in their second Phase One match of Leagues Cup 2026.
